name: Status styles help
description: Help mode entries for the Status styles plugin (help@1): every switch, list, slider and button in Settings → Plugins → Status styles.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Status styles
entries.text: Animations and styling for every status: pick how each status looks on its row and on its badge, browse the preset library and make your own presets. The status itself always comes from the VPS; this only decides how it is drawn.

entries.title: Status styles on
entries.text: Turns every status style on or off at once. Off, rows and badges look exactly as they did before the plugin; your picks are kept for when you turn it back on.

entries.title: Style rows
entries.text: When on, the row a status sits in takes that status's row style: build rows, step rows, Plan Studio lines and merge queue rows. Turn it off to keep the styles on badges only.

entries.title: Style badges
entries.text: When on, the status badge itself takes its badge style, and badge packs show their animated picture for moving statuses. Turn it off to style rows only.

entries.title: Row style
entries.text: The preset this status puts on its row: an animation on the whole row, an animation on the row's text only, or a still look. Pick Plain for no style. The sample above shows it straight away.

entries.title: Badge style
entries.text: The preset this status puts on its own badge. It only moves while Animated badge is on; otherwise the badge keeps the preset's still look.

entries.title: Animated badge
entries.text: Marks this as a moving status: its badge animates, and a badge pack shows its animated picture instead of the still one. Leave it off for resting statuses such as Landed or Failed.

entries.title: Remove status
entries.text: Takes a status you added off the list, with its style. Built-in statuses cannot be removed, only set back to Plain.

entries.title: New status
entries.text: Type the id of a status that is not listed yet, exactly as the VPS sends it (for example waiting-review), then tap Add status. Use it when a new status shows up before the plugin ships a default for it.

entries.title: Add status
entries.text: Adds the status you typed to the list under Your statuses, starting with no style, so you can pick its row and badge style.

entries.title: Back to the shipped styles
entries.text: Puts every status back to the style the plugin shipped with and removes statuses you added. Your own presets are kept. It asks first.

entries.title: Show presets
entries.text: Filters the library: every preset, only those that animate the whole row, only those that animate the text, or only the ones you made.

entries.title: Edit a copy
entries.text: Copies this preset into Make a preset below so you can change it and save it under your own name. The original is not changed.

entries.title: Remove preset
entries.text: Deletes one of your own presets. Any status still using it goes back to no style until you pick another. Built-in presets cannot be removed. It asks first.

entries.title: Preset name
entries.text: The name your preset is saved and listed under. Saving again with the same name replaces your earlier preset of that name.

entries.title: Applies to
entries.text: Whole row: the effect is drawn across the row (background, glow, movement). Text only: only the row's words change, the row itself stays still.

entries.title: Effect
entries.text: What moves: blink, pulse, a fade sweeping across, shimmer, stripes, glow and more. None makes a still preset that only uses the tint, edge bar, bold, italic and dim settings.

entries.title: Colour
entries.text: Which theme colour the effect uses: accent, green, amber, red, blue, muted or the text colour. It follows the skin, so the preset fits every theme.

entries.title: Direction
entries.text: Which way the animation runs: forwards (left to right for sweeps), backwards, or back and forth.

entries.title: Speed
entries.text: How fast the animation plays, as a percentage of its normal speed. 50% is slow and calm, 200% is twice as fast. It also follows the skin's animation speed.

entries.title: Strength
entries.text: How strong the effect is: how deep the colour goes or how far the row moves. Lower it for a subtle hint, raise it to make the row stand out.

entries.title: Still tint
entries.text: A constant background tint in the preset's colour, shown even when nothing moves. 0 means no tint.

entries.title: Dim
entries.text: Fades the whole row or badge by this much, for statuses that should sit in the background such as parked or done. 0 means not dimmed.

entries.title: Edge bar
entries.text: Draws a solid bar in the preset's colour down the left edge of the row. It stays while the row animates.

entries.title: Bold
entries.text: Makes the row's text bold while it has this status.

entries.title: Italic
entries.text: Makes the row's text italic while it has this status.

entries.title: Save preset
entries.text: Saves what you set up here as one of your own presets. It then appears in the library under Yours and in every Row style and Badge style list.

entries.title: Start over
entries.text: Clears the preset maker back to a fresh preset. Nothing saved is changed.

entries.title: Open Status styles
entries.text: Opens this plugin's settings: Settings → Plugins → Status styles.

entries.title: Reload the status styles
entries.text: Reads the saved styles from the console again and redraws every status. Use it after changing the styles from another device.
